title: Allow removing entries for disconnected screens
line: Manage Desktops and Panels offers Remove Desktop again for screens that are no longer connected, so their leftover entries can be deleted.
explanation: Manage Desktops and Panels already has a Remove Desktop action meant for desktops of screens that aren't connected, shown only when the desktop is not active. Since libplasma merged screen and lastScreen (plasma-workspace 8cf182ed49), a containment's screen() is never -1, so the model's "active" check was always true and Remove Desktop never appeared for disconnected screens, leaving no way to delete their leftover entry. The change marks a desktop active only when the screen pool has a real screen for its id, so disconnected screens get Remove Desktop back (with the usual undo notification) while connected screens still don't.

commits.message:
shell: Allow removing desktops of disconnected screens again

Since screen and lastScreen are the same thing, a containment's screen
is never -1, so desktops of disconnected screens counted as active and
had no Remove Desktop action. Check whether the screen is connected.

BUG: 486926

patches.diff:
From 560670ffaca5fd39df468b04216f3d9f8fc725f9 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 20:24:12 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] shell: Allow removing desktops of disconnected screens again

Since screen and lastScreen are the same thing, a containment's screen
is never -1, so desktops of disconnected screens counted as active and
had no Remove Desktop action. Check whether the screen is connected.

BUG: 486926
---
 shell/shellcontainmentconfig.cpp | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/shell/shellcontainmentconfig.cpp b/shell/shellcontainmentconfig.cpp
index 5bc79a9128..9c864e2105 100644
--- a/shell/shellcontainmentconfig.cpp
+++ b/shell/shellcontainmentconfig.cpp
@@ -359,7 +359,7 @@ void ShellContainmentModel::load()
         d.screen = cont->screen();
         d.edge = cont->location();
         d.activity = cont->activity();
-        d.isActive = cont->screen() != -1;
+        d.isActive = m_corona->screenPool()->screenForId(cont->screen()) != nullptr;
         d.containment = cont;
         d.image = containmentPreview(const_cast<Plasma::Containment *>(cont));
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: the menu of Disconnected Screen 2 only offers swaps, no way to remove it
Fixed: the same menu now ends with Remove Desktop
Master: leftover entries for disconnected screens stay in the window
Fixed: after Remove Desktop the Disconnected Screen 2 entry is gone, with an Undo notification

review.text: Exact root-cause fix in ShellContainmentModel::load(): checking m_corona->screenPool()->screenForId(cont->screen()) != nullptr matches ScreenPoolModel::remove() in the same file and fixes the stale cont->screen() != -1 check left over from merging screen and lastScreen. This cleanly restores the existing Remove Desktop action (with undo notification) for disconnected screens while keeping connected screens protected.
